# Untold.works

> I’m Joshua Semolik. Untold.works is my independent creative and AI consulting practice.

I help teams tell a brand or product story, build the experience around it and get it out into the world. I also build the tools and sales materials people need to keep the work moving after launch.

Email: joshua@untold.works. Phone: +1 917-665-1221. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/semolik/.

This file is a supplementary content index. The linked pages are the primary source; their visible content, roles and project status take precedence. It is not required for search or AI inclusion.

## Pages

- [Home](https://untold.works/): Untold.works offers creative direction and applied AI consulting, from brand and launch work to business workflows.
- [Brand and product](https://untold.works/brand-and-product): I help teams see how a brand will look on the shelf or in a showroom. We can test a product, a finish or a room layout before committing to production.
- [Platforms](https://untold.works/platforms): I build tools around a task your team does every day, from finding the right product image to getting a campaign approved.
- [Websites](https://untold.works/websites): I build sites around what someone came to do. That might mean choosing a table that fits, hearing a new record or finding a café in an unfamiliar city.
- [Campaigns](https://untold.works/campaigns): I develop the campaign idea, direct the images and films, and carry the story into the places people will see it.
- [Landing pages](https://untold.works/work/landing-pages): I connected the sales team to GoHighLevel, then developed ten campaign pages with the team.
- [Billiard Factory + C.L. Bailey](https://untold.works/work/billiard-factory-and-c-l-bailey): AI-assisted retail and commerce work across the new Billiard Factory front end, 27 live digital room stories, campaigns, CRM, creative systems and C.L. Bailey. Led the storefront rebuild, Shopify transition and digital Gallery with the team. I lead paid media and search, create the ads and manage the Vibe streaming TV campaign. Shopify checkout launched October 16, 2026. The XoroERP migration continues.
- [Savor](https://untold.works/work/savor): Website and content storytelling through IDW Studio; IDW led the wider Chef Series production and post work.
- [Noxguard](https://untold.works/work/noxguard): Led the rebrand, website and photo and video campaign, and helped the team organize its marketing work.
- [Second Son Productions and related music work](https://untold.works/work/robert-glasper-blue-note): Work with an artist management company and related teams across artist sites, Robert Glasper releases and films, Robtober content, separate Blue Note venue and festival roles, and independent Elena Pinderhughes and Qmillion collaborations.
- [Game Room Furniture Partners](https://untold.works/work/game-room-furniture-partners): Billiard Factory’s trade-only showroom at Dallas Market Center, focused on interior designers. Part of the Billiard Factory engagement.
- [Other Projects](https://untold.works/work/other-projects): Savor, Noxguard and further independent or agency collaborations, with live and demo status distinguished.
- [Elena Pinderhughes](https://untold.works/work/elena-pinderhughes): The debut album site for I Hope You Feel It Too.
- [Lalah Hathaway](https://untold.works/work/lalah-hathaway): Made in Chicago connects an immersive artist website with newsletter migration and custom merchandise operations, built with AI around supplied artist media. I developed the digital experience, imported 3,233 historically subscribed contacts and built the merchandise backend and staff tools. The artist site is live; public vinyl and T-shirt checkout awaits launch.
- [The art of prompting](https://untold.works/art-of-prompting): An evolving practice of turning ideas and product references into precise prompts, still images, lifestyle scenes, motion, edits and campaign assets. The AI-created C.L. Bailey Factory Event film leads, with an interactive illustrative prompt and supporting work.
- [About](https://untold.works/about): Creative leadership, brand storytelling, sales enablement, career and project credits, MIT Sloan executive education, and a working toolkit organized around AI building, creative production, commerce and measurement. Hands-on tools include Claude Code, Codex, Claude Cowork, ChatGPT, Higgsfield and Adobe Premiere; I also coordinate commerce and reporting platforms with client teams.
- [Work Together](https://untold.works/work-together): Tell me about your project, timing and budget at joshua@untold.works.
- [For Your Business](https://untold.works/for-your-business): Creative direction, digital experiences and practical AI for businesses, from an initial opportunity through launch and ongoing improvements.

Visual systems for products and places. I help teams see how a brand will look on the shelf or in a showroom. We can test a product, a finish or a room layout before committing to production.

## Credits

I directed the Spring showroom visuals and station plan. The team built the digital Gallery. I designed Content Factory and directed its implementation with the team. I supplied the Labor Day creative direction and page template. The team built the page, wrote the search copy and adapted the other landing pages. Savor work was hired through IDW Studio. This site was built with Claude.
